metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in `output/` with C++20 + standard library only:

- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)

What’s included:

- CLI flags exactly as requested: `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, `--log`
- `.bib` parser:
  - regular entries, `@string`, `@preamble`, `@comment`
  - macro expansion (with unresolved-macro warnings)
  - duplicate-key detection
  - cite-key matching case-insensitively
  - one-level `crossref` inheritance + unresolved/cycle warnings
- `.bst` parser + interpreter:
  - top-level commands (`ENTRY`, `STRINGS`, `INTEGERS`, `FUNCTION`, `MACRO`, `READ`, `EXECUTE`, `ITERATE`, `REVERSE`, `SORT`)
  - function literals, quoted function names, stack machine execution
  - built-ins used by canonical styles (`plain/alpha/unsrt/abbrv`) including `format.name$`, `change.case$`, `purify$`, `text.length$`, `text.prefix$`, `substring$`, `width$`, `write$`, `newline$`, etc.
- `.bbl` writer with BibTeX-style line wrapping behavior (79-column logic, continuation indentation, LF output)
- Structured JSON logging and structured JSON error output on failure
- Exit codes:
  - `0` success
  - `1` parse/exec/input/flag failures
  - `2` unexpected internal errors

Build verification completed successfully with:

```bash
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

I also ran end-to-end sanity runs against the provided canonical style files and sample `.bib`/cite inputs; output/log/error paths are functioning.
